slides.title: I run a daycare. Answer in one word.

slides.label: What smell am I?
slides.title: Crayons.
slides.body: And hand sanitizer. Mostly hand sanitizer.

slides.label: What object am I?
slides.title: The clipboard.
slides.body: Sign-in sheet on top. Expiring CPR cards underneath.

slides.label: What season is it for me?
slides.title: Renewal season.
slides.body: Child care license, fire inspection, staff first aid. Always something.

slides.label: What keeps me up at night?
slides.title: Dates.

slides.label: What do I need?
slides.title: Reminders.
slides.body: Daycare directors: what's your one word? Save this for renewal season.
